allow_instructions: Allow MSYS2 bash invocations under C:\msys64\usr\bin\bash.exe for PoolAI git, cargo, and bin/ scripts.
Allow cargo fmt, cargo test-ci, cargo test-raft-ci, cargo check, and cargo run --bin poolai-vision-sync / poolai-openapi-gap-audit / poolai-loc-audit in this workspace.
Allow git fetch, git status, git diff, git log, git add of scoped paths, git commit via bin/git-commit-tree-msg.sh or bin/amend-head-msg.sh, and git push origin main.
Allow reading and editing files under src/, tests/, crates/, docs/, e2e/, bin/, scripts/, and .cursor/ for PoolAI VDT drain.
Allow WebFetch and WebSearch for Cursor changelog, Run Modes docs, and PoolAI GitHub status checks.
block_instructions: Every git push --force, git reset --hard, or history rewrite (filter-repo, rebase that rewrites published main) should go through approval first.
Every command that deletes .git, modifies git config, or skips hooks with --no-verify should go through approval first.
Every command that reads or prints secrets from .env, credentials, API tokens, or private keys should go through approval first.
Every Run Everything style unrestricted shell outside the workspace should go through approval first.
Do not auto-run Python interpreters or create .py product files in this repository.
